description: This file defines data structures and classes related to RLC retransmission queue management, including retransmission items, queue state, and queue operations, for a radio communication protocol implementation.

classes.name: rlc_retx_queue_state
classes.description: Maintains the state of the retransmission queue, including total bytes and counts of retransmissions with zero and non-zero segment offsets.

classes.name: rlc_retx_queue_item
classes.description: Represents an item in the retransmission queue, including validity status and retransmission info.

classes.name: rlc_retx_queue
classes.description: Implements a queue for retransmission items with operations for adding, removing, replacing, and querying retransmission data.

classes.name: rlc_tx_amd_retx
classes.description: Represents a retransmission unit with sequence number, segment offset, length, and an inclusion check method.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if a segment range is included within the retransmission's segment range.

methods.name: get_retx_bytes
methods.description: Returns total retransmission bytes in the queue state.

methods.name: get_n_retx_so_zero
methods.description: Returns count of retransmissions with zero segment offset.

methods.name: get_n_retx_so_nonzero
methods.description: Returns count of retransmissions with non-zero segment offset.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a retransmission item to the queue state.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Removes a retransmission item from the queue state.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to add a retransmission to the queue.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the front element and cleans invalid elements.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns the first valid retransmission in the queue.

methods.name: replace_front
methods.description: Replaces the front retransmission with a new one.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the queue and resets the state.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns total number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current internal state of the queue.

methods.name: has_sn
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number exists in the queue.

methods.name: has_sn with segment check
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number with specific segment interval exists in the queue.

methods.name: remove_sn
methods.description: Removes all retransmissions with a specific sequence number.

methods.name: clean_invalid_front
methods.description: Removes invalid elements from the front of the queue.
